name: singlet_enrichment_preranked_gene_set_enrichment
title: Preranked gene set enrichment
description: Tests whether gene-set members sit at the extremes of a ranked donor-level statistic for one cell type and contrast, returning running-sum enrichment scores with Benjamini-Hochberg q-values. The default method is fgsea; gsea_permutation gives a fixed-permutation reference. Reads a genes-by-contrasts statistic from pseudobulk DE and writes per-set ES, NES, p, FDR and leading-edge genes. Do not use it on per-cell scores, cell-level DE or thresholded gene lists; use over-representation for those.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

ranking.description: The gene-level statistic that genes are ranked by.

de_name.description: varm member holding the genes-by-contrasts statistic matrix from pseudobulk DE.

contrast.description: Column of the statistic matrix to rank genes by.

statistic.description: Moderated or mixed-model t is preferred; logfc is for comparison only.

gene_sets.description: Gene-set collection and size limits, applied within the ranked universe.

collection.description: uns member holding gene sets as a name-to-members mapping.

min_size.description: Minimum set members present in the ranked universe.

max_size.description: Maximum set members present in the ranked universe.

symbol_key.description: var column matching set members; var_names uses the index.

method.description: fgsea: adaptive multilevel p-values (default). gsea_permutation: fixed-permutation reference.

fgsea.description: Options read only when method is fgsea.

eps.description: Lower bound on reported p-values in the multilevel estimator.

score_type.description: std is two-sided; pos or neg only for a directional hypothesis.

sample_size.description: Sample size of the multilevel estimator (fgsea sampleSize).

n_perm_simple.description: Simple permutations that seed the multilevel estimator.

gsea_permutation.description: Options read only when method is gsea_permutation.

n_perm.description: Membership permutations per set; p-values cannot resolve below about 2/n_perm.

device.description: fgsea runs on CPU; gsea_permutation uses CUDA when cuda is requested or auto finds enough memory.

seed.description: Random seed for membership permutations and multilevel sampling.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/gsea/<de_name>/<contrast>. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: n_gene_sets_tested, n_fdr_below_0_05, method, top_sets (up to 10 by absolute NES). Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
